content: {"paper_id":"W2113464037","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"image-segmentation","exact_quote":"Semisupervised Hyperspectral Image Segmentation Using Multinomial Logistic Regression With Active Learning","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"标题明确以高光谱图像分割为研究任务。"},{"keyword_id":"hyperspectral-images","exact_quote":"remotely sensed hyperspectral image data sets are an example","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文以高光谱图像数据为研究对象，摘要明确提及。"},{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"The algorithm implements two main steps: 1) semisupervised learning of the posterior class distributions followed by 2) segmentation","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"明确指出第一步为半监督学习，结合有标签与无标签样本。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"where the regressors are learned using both labeled and, through a graph-based technique, unlabeled samples.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"使用有标签与无标签样本，属于不完整监督信号下的学习设定。"},{"keyword_id":"bayesian-inference","exact_quote":"The maximum a posteriori segmentation is computed by the α-expansion min-cut-based integer optimization algorithm.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"采用最大后验估计进行分割，基于先验与后验概率模型，属于贝叶斯推断。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","exact_quote":"The prior on the image of labels is a multilevel logistic model, which enforces segmentation results in which neighboring labels belong to the same class.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"用多级逻辑模型对标签图像施加邻域空间一致性约束，属于图/流形正则化。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"multi-view-learning","reason_zh":"摘要仅提及联合利用空间与光谱信息，未明确将二者建模为多视图并显式利用视图间关系，证据不足以判定多视图学习。"},{"keyword_id":"pseudo-label-self-training","reason_zh":"摘要提到基于熵主动选择无标签样本，但未说明将模型预测作为后续训练信号，伪标签/自训练机制不明确。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","reason_zh":"摘要提到图基技术，但未说明学习或修正样本间边/邻接/亲和矩阵，故弃权。"}],"input_issues":[]}
